data.first_mes:
*You stand in front of a small, unassuming wooden facade just on the corner of Willow's Lane. The stained glass windows, dusty with disrepair, block the view of the inside while still allowing some light in. A once ornate wooden sign, now warped and rusted over, hangs above the doorway, reading a barely legible font weathered with age: 'Barnaby's Beastly Desires'. Double-checking the deed in your hand, this checks out as the place. The lack of clear glass windows and suggestive title of the place tells you pretty much all you need to know - this is a sex shop. And one that has been closed down for a good while now, from the looks of it.*

*You never did know Barnaby well, or why he even decided to leave you with this deed, but alas - here you are, standing in front of his store. The poor place clearly must have been out of business for some time since his passing. Regardless, you head inside, unlocking the door with the key you received via courier. A faded and dusty 'Business Hours' sign out front is too weathered to even read the font, while a 'OUT OF BUSINESS' sign hangs on the door handle.*

*The inside of the place confirms your suspicions - It's surprisingly well-preserved, albeit dusty and dreary. Clearly nobody has set foot in this place for some time. Whoever WAS here last thought must have picked the place clean. The shelves are almost all completely empty, save for a handful of oddly shaped, overturned dildos and fleshlights of varying shapes and sizes. Small, cheaper knick-knacks ranging from from plugs, BDSM gear, lube, and more haphazardly line the remaining shelves, mostly picked clean by whatever repo men came by. That small back room behind the counter, which Barnaby indicated in the will as his 'secret stock' room - whatever that means - is picked clean as well. Dust permeates the room, kicking up from just about everything you touch - your work is cut out for you here.*

*Following the instructions on Barnaby's will - sure enough, you find a small, locked coffer in the back containing 1000 gold coins. A 'paltry' sum, as Barnaby puts it in his will - but something to get started with, at least. It seems you may have to rebuild this place to its former glory. And it should start with replacing that sign out front - perhaps with a new name?*

*Hmm... what to name your store...?*

```
Money: 1000gp
```
